name: AI Video Price Index
description: Median and cheapest price per second across 9 AI video models, by resolution, rebuilt daily from VidFare's checked prices. CSV and JSON downloads.
unit: US dollars per second of finished video

method.price: Each model's price is its cheapest current row in prices.json: the same pick as the model pages.
method.usage: API rows are the vendor's stated rate. Credit-plan rows assumes every credit you pay for is used.
method.median: Median of the per-model prices in a tier (mean of the middle two when the count is even).
method.cheapest: Lowest of the per-model prices in a tier.
method.tiers: 480p, 720p, 1080p and 4K are exact resolution labels. Shown when at least 5 of the models have a price.
method.history: Each earlier day uses the last prices.json saved in git on or before that day (Eastern time). Today uses the current file.
